Để viết CV IT ấn tượng, bạn nên:

1. **Thông tin cá nhân**: Họ tên, email, phone, LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio
2. **Mục tiêu nghề nghiệp**: 2-3 câu tóm tắt vị trí mong muốn & điểm mạnh
3. **Kỹ năng kỹ thuật**: Phân loại rõ ràng (Languages, Frameworks, Databases, Tools, Cloud...)
4. **Dự án**: Tên dự án, công nghệ dùng, vai trò, kết quả đạt được (có số liệu)
5. **Kinh nghiệm làm việc**: Công ty, vị trí, thời gian, trách nhiệm chính, achievements
6. **Giáo dục**: Đại học, chuyên ngành, GPA (nếu > 3.0), chứng chỉ

💡 Mẹo: Dùng động từ hành động (developed, built, optimized, led) và định lượng kết quả (giảm 30% latency, tăng 20% conversion).

Bạn muốn tôi gợi ý template CV cho vị trí cụ thể nào (Frontend, Backend, Fullstack, DevOps, Data...)?

**Template CV Frontend Developer**

**Kỹ năng bắt buộc**:
- HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript
- React/Vue/Angular (chọn 1 mạnh)
- State management: Redux/Vuex/Zustand/Pinia
- Styling: Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, CSS Modules
- Build tools: Vite, Webpack
- Testing: Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Cypress

**Dự án nổi bật**:
- Web app có tính năng phức tạp (auth, real-time, payment...)
- Performance optimization (lazy loading, code splitting, bundle analysis)
- Accessibility (WCAG), SEO, Cross-browser compatibility

**Plus points**: Next.js/SSR, Micro-frontends, Storybook, Design Systems, Web Vitals

**Template CV Backend Developer**

**Kỹ năng bắt buộc**:
- Ngôn ngữ: Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Java, Go (chọn 1-2 mạnh)
- Framework: Express/NestJS/Fastify, Django/FastAPI, Spring Boot, Gin/Echo
- Database: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
- API Design: REST, GraphQL, gRPC
- Auth: JWT, OAuth2, OpenID Connect
- Message Queue: RabbitMQ, Kafka, NATS
- Container: Docker, Kubernetes basics

**Dự án nổi bật**:
- Microservices architecture, System design
- Performance tuning (query optimization, caching, indexing)
- CI/CD pipelines, Observability (logging, metrics, tracing)
- Security: Rate limiting, input validation, encryption

**Template CV DevOps / Platform Engineer**

**Kỹ năng bắt buộc**:
- Cloud: AWS/Azure/GCP (chọn 1 sâu)
- IaC: Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation
- Container: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE/AKS), Helm
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, ArgoCD
- Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog
- Scripting: Bash, Python, Go
- Linux: Networking, Security, Performance tuning

**Dự án nổi bật**:
- GitOps workflow, Multi-cluster management
- Cost optimization, Auto-scaling policies
- Disaster recovery, Backup strategies
- Platform engineering: Internal developer platform

**Các lỗi thường gặp trong CV IT:**

❌ **Quá chung chung**: "Proficient in Java" → ✅ "Built REST APIs with Spring Boot handling 10k req/s"
❌ **Liệt kê công nghệ không biết sâu**: Để 20+ tech stack → Chỉ giữ 8-10 tech thực sự thành thạo
❌ **Thiếu dự án thực tế**: Chỉ có bài tập lớp → Làm side project, contribute open source
❌ **Format xấu**: Font không đồng bộ, căn lề lệch, file .docx bị vỡ layout → Dùng PDF, template clean
❌ **Không định lượng**: "Cải thiện performance" → "Giảm API response time từ 800ms xuống 120ms (85%)"
❌ **Lỗi chính tả/ngữ pháp**: Dùng Grammarly, nhờ người review
❌ **CV quá dài**: >2 trang cho junior, >3 trang cho senior → Gọn gàng, tập trung vào 3-5 năm gần nhất

**Mẹo tìm việc IT hiệu quả:**

1. **Xác định mục tiêu**: Vị trí, tech stack, mức lương, loại hình (remote/hybrid/onsite)
2. **Tối ưu LinkedIn**: Headline rõ ràng, About section kể story, Skills có endorsement
3. **Nguồn tìm việc**:
   - LinkedIn Jobs, VietnamWorks, TopCV, ITviec
   - Company career pages (direct apply)
   - Referral từ network (tỷ lệ pass cao nhất)
   - Community: Facebook groups, Discord, Telegram IT jobs
4. **Customize CV**: Tune skills/keywords cho từng JD
5. **Cover letter**: Ngắn gọn, nêu tại sao phù hợp, call to action
6. **Theo dõi**: Spreadsheet track (company, role, date, status, contact)
7. **Follow up**: Email sau 1 tuần nếu chưa có phản hồi

**Chuẩn bị phỏng vấn IT:**

**1. Technical:**
- **DSA**: LeetCode Easy/Medium (Array, String, HashMap, Two Pointers, Sliding Window, Tree, Graph)
- **System Design**: Scalability, Database sharding, Caching, Load balancing, Message queues
- **Domain knowledge**: Đặc thù vị trí (Frontend: rendering, state, perf; Backend: concurrency, DB, API)

**2. Behavioral (STAR method):**
- Situation, Task, Action, Result
- Chuẩn bị 5-7 stories: Challenge, Conflict, Failure, Leadership, Learning, Project success

**3. Questions for interviewer:**
- Team structure, tech stack, current challenges
- On-call, deployment process, code review culture
- Career growth, mentorship, learning budget

**4. Mock interview**: Pramp, interviewing.io, hoặc nhờ bạn bè practice

**System Design Basics cho phỏng vấn:**

**Core Concepts:**
- **Scalability**: Vertical vs Horizontal scaling
- **Load Balancing**: L4 vs L7, algorithms (Round Robin, Least Connections, Consistent Hashing)
- **Caching**: Redis, Memcached - Write-through, Write-back, Cache-aside
- **Database**: Replication, Sharding, Partitioning, CAP theorem
- **Message Queue**: Kafka, RabbitMQ - Pub/Sub, Work queues, Dead letter queues
- **API Gateway**: Rate limiting, Auth, Routing
- **Observability**: Metrics, Logs, Traces (RED method, USE method)

**Common Problems:**
- URL Shortener, Pastebin, Instagram Feed, Chat App, Rate Limiter
- Design TikTok/YouTube (video processing, CDN, transcoding)
- Design Uber/DoorDash (real-time matching, geospatial)

**Framework**: Clarify requirements → Estimate scale → API design → Data model → High-level design → Deep dive → Bottlenecks

**Frontend Developer Roadmap 2024:**

**Phase 1 - Foundation (2-3 tháng):**
- HTML5, CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, Animations, Responsive)
- JavaScript ES6+ (Async/await, Modules, DOM, Events)
- TypeScript (Types, Interfaces, Generics, Utility types)
- Git/GitHub, VS Code, Chrome DevTools

**Phase 2 - Framework (3-4 tháng):**
- React (Hooks, Context, Redux Toolkit/Zustand, React Query/TanStack Query)
- Next.js 14+ (App Router, Server Components, SSR/SSG/ISR)
- Testing: Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright

**Phase 3 - Advanced (ongoing):**
- Performance: Bundle analysis, Code splitting, Web Vitals
- Architecture: Micro-frontends, Module Federation, Monorepo (Turborepo/Nx)
- Design Systems: Storybook, Tailwind, Radix UI, shadcn/ui
- Full-stack: tRPC, GraphQL, Next.js API Routes, Database (Prisma/Drizzle)

**Projects để build:** Todo App → E-commerce → Dashboard → Real-time Chat → SaaS boilerplate

**Backend Developer Roadmap 2024:**

**Phase 1 - Foundation (2-3 tháng):**
- Ngôn ngữ: Go / Python / Node.js / Java (chọn 1)
- CS Basics: OS, Networking (HTTP/TCP/IP), Database (SQL, Index, Transaction)
- Linux CLI, Git, Docker basics

**Phase 2 - Core Backend (3-4 tháng):**
- Framework: Gin/Echo, FastAPI/Django, Spring Boot, NestJS
- Database: PostgreSQL (Advanced), Redis, MongoDB
- API: REST (OpenAPI/Swagger), GraphQL, gRPC
- Auth: JWT, OAuth2, Session, RBAC
- Testing: Unit, Integration, Contract testing

**Phase 3 - Distributed Systems (ongoing):**
- Message Queue: Kafka, RabbitMQ, NATS
- Microservices: Service discovery, Config management, Circuit breaker
- Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Jaeger, ELK
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD
- Cloud: AWS/GCP/Azure (1 provider sâu)
- Security: OWASP Top 10, Rate limiting, Encryption

**Projects:** CRUD API → Auth Service → E-commerce Backend → Microservices Demo → System Design Case Study

**DevOps / SRE Roadmap 2024:**

**Phase 1 - Linux & Scripting (1-2 tháng):**
- Linux: File system, Permissions, Process, Networking, Systemd, Shell scripting
- Python/Go cho automation scripts
- Git: Branching strategy, Conventional commits

**Phase 2 - Container & Orchestration (2-3 tháng):**
- Docker: Multi-stage builds, BuildKit, Security scanning (Trivy)
- Kubernetes: Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMap/Secret, HPA, Operators
- Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD (GitOps)

**Phase 3 - Cloud & IaC (2-3 tháng):**
- Cloud provider: AWS (EC2, VPC, RDS, EKS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch)
- Terraform: Modules, State management, Workspaces
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions/GitLab CI - Pipelines, Environments, Secrets

**Phase 4 - Observability & Platform (ongoing):**
- Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, Alertmanager
- Logging: Loki, ELK/EFK
- Tracing: Jaeger, Tempo
- Platform Engineering: Backstage, Internal Developer Platform
- Security: Policy as Code (OPA), Supply chain security (SLSA, Cosign)

**Certifications**: CKAD → CKA → CKS → AWS Solutions Architect / GCP Cloud Engineer

**Đàm phán lương IT hiệu quả:**

**Trước khi đàm phán:**
- Research market rate: Glassdoor, Levels.fyi, NodeFlair, VietnamWorks Salary Guide
- Biết giá trị của mình: Years of experience, Tech stack depth, Domain knowledge, Soft skills
- Chuẩn bị số liệu: Current package, Expected range (min - target - stretch)

**Khi nhận offer:**
1. **Đừng nói yes ngay**: "Cảm ơn, cho tôi 2-3 ngày xem xét"
2. **Counter offer**: Nêu số liệu market, value bạn mang lại
3. **Negotiate package toàn diện**: Base + Bonus + Equity + Benefits (WFH, learning budget, insurance, leave)

**Scripts:**
- "Dựa trên research market cho vị trí này tại [city] với [years] năm kinh nghiệm [tech stack], range là X-Y. Với background của em, em mong đợi Z."
- "Em rất hứng thú với role này. Base salary em mong đợi là Z. Có flexibility về signing bonus hoặc equity không?"

**Lưu ý**: Junior ít leverage hơn → focus learning/growth. Senior/Lead → focus impact/leadership.

**Chiến lược phát triển sự nghiệp IT:**

**Junior (0-2 năm) → Mid (2-4 năm):**
- Depth: Master 1 tech stack, hiểu sâu internals
- Breadth: Hiểu end-to-end flow (FE→BE→DB→Deploy)
- Ownership: Làm feature độc lập, viết test, review code
- Visibility: Demo, write docs, share knowledge

**Mid (3-5 năm) → Senior (5+ năm):**
- System Design: Design scalable, maintainable systems
- Mentorship: Guide juniors, code review quality
- Cross-team: Collab với PM, Design, QA, DevOps
- Decision making: Trade-offs, tech debt, architecture choices

**Senior → Staff/Principal / Engineering Manager:**
- **IC Track**: Technical strategy, org-wide impact, standards, hiring bar
- **Management Track**: People management, career growth, planning, culture

**Core skills mọi level:**
- Communication: Viết rõ ràng, trình bày thuyết phục
- Problem solving: First principles, root cause analysis
- Learning: Continuous, practical, teach others
- Business awareness: Hiểu product, user, revenue

**Tài nguyên học tập IT chất lượng (Free/Paid):**

**System Design & Architecture:**
- 📖 *Designing Data-Intensive Applications* (DDIA) - Martin Kleppmann
- 🌐 System Design Primer (GitHub - donnemartin)
- 🎥 ByteByteGo, System Design Interview (Alex Xu)
- 🌐 HighScalability.com case studies

**Backend & Distributed Systems:**
- 📖 *Clean Architecture* - Robert Martin
- 📖 *Building Microservices* - Sam Newman
- 🌐 Martin Fowler blogs (martinfowler.com)
- 🎥 ArjanCodes (YouTube - Python architecture)

**Frontend:**
- 🌐 React Official Docs (new beta docs)
- 🌐 TypeScript Handbook
- 🎥 Theo (t3.gg), Jack Herrington, Web Dev Simplified
- 🌐 Frontend Masters (paid, high quality)

**DevOps & Cloud:**
- 🌐 Kubernetes the Hard Way (Kelsey Hightower)
- 🎥 TechWorld with Nana (YouTube)
- 🌐 AWS/GCP/Azure Well-Architected Frameworks
- 📖 *Site Reliability Engineering* (Google SRE book - free online)

**Algorithms & Interview:**

- 🌐 LeetCode (Grind 75, Blind 75)
- 📖 *Grokking the Coding Interview* (patterns)
- 🌐 Hello Interview (system design + behavioral)

**Vietnam Community:**
- 🌐 Facebook: "Lập trình viên Việt Nam", "IT Jobs Vietnam"
- 🌐 Discord: VN Dev Community, Go/Vietnam, React Vietnam
- 📺 YouTube: F8 Fullstack, Code Dạo, Nguyen Duc Hoang

**Dự án Portfolio ấn tượng cho CV:**

**Tier 1 - Cơ bản (Junior):**
- Todo App (CRUD, Auth, State management)
- Blog/CMS (Markdown, SEO, RSS)
- Weather Dashboard (API integration, Charts)
- E-commerce Mini (Cart, Checkout mock, Payment sandbox)

**Tier 2 - Trung cấp (Mid):**
- **Real-time Chat App**: WebSocket, Rooms, Typing indicator, File upload
- **Task Management**: Kanban board, Drag-drop, Collaboration, Notifications
- **URL Shortener**: Analytics, QR code, Custom domain, Rate limiting
- **Dashboard Admin**: RBAC, Charts, Export, Bulk actions

**Tier 3 - Nâng cao (Senior+):**
- **Microservices E-commerce**: API Gateway, Services (User, Product, Order, Payment, Inventory), Event-driven, Saga pattern
- **DevOps Platform**: CI/CD pipeline, Preview environments, Feature flags, Observability stack
- **Open Source Contribution**: PR đến project phổ biến (React, Vue, Kubernetes, Terraform providers...)
- **SaaS Boilerplate**: Auth, Billing (Stripe), Multi-tenancy, Admin panel, Email, Docs

**Mẹo:** Deploy production (Vercel, Railway, Fly.io, AWS), CI/CD, Monitoring, Custom domain, README chuyên nghiệp với architecture diagram

**Tech Trends 2024-2025 IT Developer nên biết:**

**AI/GenAI trong Development:**
- **AI Coding Assistants**: GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Codeium, Tabnine, Continue.dev
- **Local LLMs**: Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp - chạy model local cho privacy
- **RAG & Agents**: LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen - build AI apps
- **Vector DBs**: Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, ChromaDB, pgvector

**Frontend:**
- **React 19**: Server Components, Actions, use() hook, Compiler
- **Signals**: SolidJS, Preact, @preact/signals - fine-grained reactivity
- **Web Components**: Lit, Enhance, native Custom Elements
- **Islands Architecture**: Astro, Fresh, Qwik - partial hydration

**Backend & Infrastructure:**
- **Rust in backend**: Axum, Actix, Tokio - performance + safety
- **Edge Computing**: Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, Deno Deploy
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 16/17 (JSONB, vector), SQLite (Turso, LibSQL), DuckDB (analytics)
- **Observability**: OpenTelemetry standard, Grafana Cloud, Honeycomb

**DevEx:**
- **Monorepo**: Turborepo, Nx, Moonrepo
- **Package managers**: pnpm, Bun (fast, built-in tooling)
- **API**: tRPC (end-to-end type safety), GraphQL Federation

**Học gì ưu tiên:** AI-assisted coding workflow + 1 modern stack depth + System design fundamentals
